goal: Contain repeated SummonScoutFrame runtime errors currently rethrown through SummonScout_WhisperConfirmSpam.lua so one bad core event cannot flood the Blizzard error popup; preserve the original error text in persistent hot state for diagnosis and show at most one controlled chat report per distinct error/cooldown window.
notes: Adds a final TOC-loaded hot guard that unwraps its own previous generation safely, wraps the currently composed SummonScoutFrame OnEvent handler with pcall, suppresses repeated Blizzard error popups, stores exact error text/time in W112_SUMMONSCOUT_HOT.state.coreerrorguard and H.lastError, and emits only a throttled controlled chat line. Existing invite, payment, routing and ritual handlers are otherwise untouched.
